package store

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// RunDynamic hides a tracked pgx method behind a bound identifier: run is a method value, not
// a selector expression, so call.Fun is a bare *ast.Ident and a guard that only recognises
// pool.Query(...)-shaped selector calls never notices that run(ctx, dyn) is the same call.
func RunDynamic(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, dyn string) {
	run := pool.Query
	run(ctx, dyn)
}
